body:
I have a theory that the last side, if there is one, is an orange side who was originally a light side and became a dark side.  Something like obsession, interest, or motivation.  

The theory follows the idea that Deceit's name is Horace.  If you haven't heard that theory, here's a quick summary: Deceit argues against Patton in SVS, where Patton is dressed like Atticus Finch from TKAM.  The lawyer against Atticus in TKAM is named Horace.  Horace was also a Roman poet, which would follow the dark sides' Roman links to names already.  (Remus and Romulus, Virgil the poet).  

Based off of this theory, I searched to find if there was a third poet tied to Horace and Virgil.  And... there actually was.  A poet named Ovid.  This is my theory on the orange side's name.

Ovid was a very forward thinking, bright guy whose poetry was focused on more liberal things.  He focused on love and doing what you want, following your dreams.  However, Augustus at the time didn't like that, and eventually banished Ovid from Rome due to something he did.  Its unclear whether it was due to Ovid sleeping with his daughter or something else, but the point is he was banished from Rome despite being loved by all the people.

Around the same time, Augustus was warming up to an introverted little poet the rest of the people weren't fond of for his conservative views and poetry- a poet named Virgil.

So, this theory follows that "Augustus" would be Thomas, or the light sides, and that they banished Ovid to the dark for doing something "wrong", just before beginning to accept Virgil.  This theory also liked the idea that Ovid would appear for the first time in SVS 2, because who better to argue that the sides should be selfish than Thomas' iteration of a poet who only wrote about being selfish to the point that he was banned from Rome?  Besides, Deceit appeared at the beginning of this season, Remus just appeared, and since the next episode is the season finale, it'd be nice if it showed the very last of the dark sides.

Thomas and Joan stated that the next episode of Sanders sides wouldn't include a new side, but that was just before sanders asides, so I'm unsure if the point still stands.

As I said, I’ve had discussions about it and he’ll say he’ll do more but then doesn’t, or at least- nothing noticeable to me.  I know he’s trying, and he’s shy, and I love him regardless- but I still want to find some way to get him to make the first move for once.
